Guidance for `umami-kotlin`, a Kotlin Multiplatform wrapper for the Umami web analytics REST API.

Modules: `:umami` (core), `:sample:simple-compose-app`, `:sample:terminalApp`. `:umami` packages: `api` (REST communication), `core` (HTTP client/event queue), `domain` (models/value objects). Uses Ktor, Kotlinx Coroutines, Kotlinx Serialization, `kotlin.time.Instant`, Kermit, Kotest, and Mokkery. New tests should use Kotest matchers (e.g., `shouldBe`) instead of `kotlin.test` assertions. Architecture uses `UmamiOptionsBuilder` (Builder), `Umami` (Facade), and a Kotlin `Channel` producer-consumer queue.

All contributions must adhere to the guidelines outlined in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

Gradle project; recommended IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition or Android Studio. Detekt config: `detekt/detekt.yml`; it runs automatically before a git push. Qlty config: `.qlty/qlty.toml`. Please ensure your changes do not introduce any new static analysis issues. Kover enforces coverage; minimums are in root `build.gradle.kts`.

All new features must be accompanied by tests. Bug fixes should also include a test that reproduces the bug.

When verifying that your changes compile and work correctly, run the JVM tests for the specific module you modified. Using `jvmTest` ensures compatibility with environments that don't have the Android SDK installed:
```
./gradlew :umami:jvmTest
./gradlew :umami-api:jvmTest
./gradlew :sample:terminalApp:jvmTest
```
Tests also verify compilation. Full multiplatform compilation/integration checks run in CI.

Dokka docs: `./gradlew dokkaHtml`. Publishing uses `maven-publish` to Maven Central.

This file is a living document. If you make significant architectural changes, add a new major library, or change the build process, please update this file accordingly.
